title: Invoice
description: A complete invoice document: parties, line items, tax, total, and the button that gets it paid.
usage: The billing page every freelancer and SaaS already redraws badly. Amounts are tabular, the total is unambiguous, and the status badge says where things stand — Paid, Open, Overdue (the badge turns danger, the words never shout). Print styles are the obvious next step: an invoice that cannot be printed is a screenshot.
